body:
Dioptase in Matrix is rarely found in tumbled form, making this collection especially unique. Sourced from a limited Tucson Gem Show run, each stone was hand-selected by us for its quality and energetic depth.

Dioptase is a powerful heart-healing stone, known for its ability to release emotional wounds, past pain, and lingering attachments. In matrix form, its energy is grounded—allowing deep healing without overwhelm.

This stone supports forgiveness, compassion, and emotional growth. It helps you stay present while gently releasing what no longer serves you.

Dioptase encourages heart-led living, allowing you to move forward with openness, strength, and clarity.

Rare and transformative, this stone is for those ready to heal deeply and live fully.
